timing.eligibility_freeze: after architecture-neutral familiarization/engagement screening and before architecture-specific training or treatment outcomes
timing.treatment_assignment: after eligible roster and colony IDs are frozen

eligible_roster.hash_rule: the exact eligible roster CSV is SHA-256 hashed in the randomization receipt
eligible_roster.replacement_rule: eligible but unassigned individuals remain explicitly unassigned; do not add them later based on treatment performance or outcomes

blocking.rule: complete 12-cell treatment blocks are formed within a single colony; each complete block assigns exactly one individual to every architecture x access x budget cell
blocking.reason: prevents colony identity from becoming confounded with treatment-cell imbalance
blocking.individuals_per_cell: equals the total number of complete colony blocks across colonies
blocking.counterbalance_rule: individuals per cell must be a multiple of four so each treatment cell receives the four cue-symbol profiles equally often

allocation.algorithm: allocate complete blocks across colonies as evenly as possible subject to each colony's floor(n_eligible/12) block capacity; break equal-capacity choices by the frozen RNG seed
allocation.within_block: shuffle the 12 eligible individuals and 12 treatment cells with the frozen seed
allocation.counterbalance_profile: one frozen cue-symbol profile per complete block, cycling cb0,cb1,cb2,cb3 across global blocks
allocation.excess_individuals: returned in a separate unassigned CSV

outputs: JSON randomization receipt with roster SHA-256, eligibility rule, seed, colony block capacity and balance audits

finalization.current_status: actual eligible roster not yet available
required_before_confirmatory_collection: eligible roster and colony IDs frozen
definitive individuals-per-cell frozen by final power operating-characteristic surface
assignment and unassigned artifacts generated and checksum-frozen before architecture-specific training

forbidden: selecting replacement individuals after seeing architecture-specific training or test performance
randomizing individuals before the architecture-neutral eligibility rule is applied
allowing a colony to contribute only selected treatment cells when complete-block capacity exists
changing treatment assignments to improve apparent colony balance after outcomes are observed
treating unassigned eligible individuals as an outcome-dependent reserve
claim_ceiling: The algorithm removes avoidable treatment-colony imbalance by design. It does not make colony a negligible biological source of variation; colony remains a hierarchical factor in the frozen analysis.
